arabic text:
Yeh phool nabi ke gulshan
ke
Karbal sehra me aaye hai
Yeh raazi hai qurbaani per
Karte hai wohi jo rab ki raza
english translation text:
These flowers from the Prophet's
garden have come to the
desert of Karbala; they are
content with sacrifice, and do
only what pleases their Lord

arabic text:
Phir maahe muharam aa
pohncha
Har majlis me pursa lene
Hujjat sarkar ke aane par
Matam daaron ne adab se
kaha
english translation text:
The month of Muharram
has again arrived. At
every gathering, when the
Hujjat of the age
comes to receive condolences,
the mourners respectfully say:

arabic text:
Akbar ka sar aaghosh me tha
Mola ne kahaa himat karna
Barchi
me
jigar
se
kheechunga
Yeh sunkar beta bol utha
english translation text:
Akbar's head rested
in his lap.
The Maula said:
remain courageous; I
will pull the
spear from your
heart. Hearing this,
the son cried:

arabic text:
Mashkeeza Sakina ka lekar
Paani lane abbas gaye
Jab aate dekha ghazi ko
Har mowj ne darya ki yeh
kahaa
english translation text:
Carrying Sakina's water-skin, Abbas
went to bring water.
When every wave of
the river saw the
Ghazi approaching, it said:

arabic text:
Tha
apne
amal
par
sharminda
Hasrat thi dil me muaafi ki
Mola shabir ki kidmat mein
Hathon ko bandhe hur aya
english translation text:
He was ashamed
of his own
deeds, and his
heart longed for
forgiveness. With
his hands bound,
Hurr came
before Maula Shabbir

arabic text:
Ik nanhi rooh gayi janat
Sukhi thi zabaan zakhmi tha
gala
Matam barpa tha malaik me
Jibreel ne rokar arze kia
english translation text:
A tiny soul went to Paradise;
his tongue was dry and his throat
was wounded.
Mourning arose among the angels,
and Jibraeel wept and said:

arabic text:
Jab saray jari qurban huwe
Mola ki siwa koi na raha
Maqtal ki taraf mola jo chale
Ghore ne tadap kar jaise kaha
english translation text:
When every brave warrior had been sacrificed
and no one remained except the Maula,
he began walking towards the battlefield;
his horse writhed as though saying:

arabic text:
Wo sab se bara gham dunya
ka
Likhna to kamala asaan na
tha
Aayi jo zabaan per naade ali
Karnay ko madad aaye mola
english translation text:
It was the greatest
grief in the world;
writing it, Kamala, was
no easy task. When Nad-e-Ali
came to her lips,
the Maula came to help
